title: Output Schema for move Operation
description: Output schema for the move operation in the connector.

payload.description: The main response payload from the move operation.

success.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

inferred.description: True when a retry after a lost reply found the source gone and the target matching, so the operation is reported as done by inference.

targetComplete.description: True when the operation failed but the target is complete, for example when the source could not be deleted after the copy.

filesMoved.description: The members of the source folder that were moved, relative to the source folder.

filesLeft.description: The members of the folder that the operation left in place.

name.description: The member, relative to the folder.

reason.description: Why the member was left: FILTERED, RESERVED, LOCKED, REMOVED, APPLICATION_ERROR, UNCLEAR, or the name of the error of the member.

error.description: Error information if the operation was unsuccessful.
